{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm number of rows with missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Number of rows with missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}")

# Confirm the total number of rows after dropping missing values
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing flipper_length_mm: {len(penguins_clean)}")

# Check for outliers using IQR method
Q1 = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].quantile(0.25)
Q3 = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

outliers = penguins_clean[(penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'] < lower_bound) | (penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'] > upper_bound)]
print(f"Number of outliers (by IQR method): {len(outliers)}")
print(f"Outlier values: {outliers['flipper_length_mm'].tolist()}")"}
